resources.string: Shown while the Feelcoin miner is running
Pool: pool.feelcoin.org:4244 TLS by default, 4242 plaintext alternative · 0% donate · GPL-3.0\nOfficial Feelcoin Miner v0.1.0, based on XMRig. This app does not take a cut.
Mines Feelcoin on ARM64 devices. Experimental — generates heat and drains battery. No warranty, use at your own risk.
Tip: paste only the public Receive address. Never a seed, private key, or password.
